name: Karo
source:
Karo (full name is Karo Arnas) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Karo is a young adult green-eyed om'verai with a sharp "beard". Karo's head is full of sharp spikes, belly plates are darker.
A calm and shy non-confident son of a business lady, needing someone to reveal what is hidden inside his mind.
